title: P41 — Upgrade google_mobile_ads to fix Play Billing Library warning
context: Play Console shows error: 'Your app currently uses Play Billing Library version 7.1.1 and must be updated to at least version 8.0.0'. This comes from google_mobile_ads ^9.1.0 which bundles an old Billing Library. Fix by upgrading to google_mobile_ads ^10.x or the latest stable version that includes Billing Library 8+.
steps: 1. Run: flutter pub outdated — note the latest version of google_mobile_ads
2. In pubspec.yaml update: google_mobile_ads: ^10.0.0 (or latest stable ≥10)
5. Run: flutter analyze — fix any errors from API changes in the new version
6. Check lib/ for any google_mobile_ads imports that use deprecated APIs and update them
7. Run: flutter build apk --debug — must succeed
8. Run: flutter build appbundle --release -- must succeed with key.properties in place
9. Commit: 'fix(ads): upgrade google_mobile_ads to fix Play Billing Library 8+ requirement'
do_not: Never read or print key.properties or keystore
success_criteria: flutter build appbundle --release succeeds AND google_mobile_ads version in pubspec.yaml is ≥10.0.0
